To determine if the red line is always lower than the green dashed line across all shown noise ratios, we need to compare their positions on the y-axis. From the figure, it appears that the red line (Encoder Input) is consistently below the green dashed line (Decoder Input) across all noise ratios. However, the blue dotted line (Encoder Output) is also present and is positioned between the red and green lines, indicating that the relationship between the red and green lines may not be consistent across all noise ratios.

Therefore, based on the provided information, the red line is generally lower than the green dashed line across most of the noise ratios, but there might be some exceptions at higher noise ratios where the blue dotted line could intersect or cross the red line.
